It is suitable for beginners to experience black and white shooting, and also meets the pursuit of film texture and expressiveness by advanced users. At the same time, the film performs stably under standard black and white development processes, making it a practical choice for daily creations and experimental darkroom processing.

name: PF 2
description: Wolfen PF2 is a special black-and-white negative film from the German ORWO brand. It is famous for its extremely low sensitivity. Its nominal ISO 3 sensitivity design makes it extremely unique in traditional black-and-white photography. Originally intended for film duplication and high-quality printing, uses include technical printing and copymaking, but can also be used for still photography creations. The grains of PF2 are extremely fine, the resolution is excellent, the grayscale transition is natural, and it can express extremely rich mid-tones and details. Its transparent film base coupled with an antistatic coating not only helps reduce dust adsorption, but also keeps the screen clean in special applications. Due to its ultra-low sensitivity design, PF2 is suitable for use in well-lit environments, and is especially suitable for photography creators and experimental projects that pursue extremely high quality and film-like image quality. The properties of PF2 make it uniquely suitable for black and white printing, reverse imaging, or experimental darkroom processing.

name: UN 54
description: Wolfen UN54 is a traditional black-and-white negative film from the German ORWO brand. It is derived from the classic emulsion of ORWO film film and has profound history and image characteristics. UN54 is a full-color black-and-white negative film with a nominal sensitivity of ISO100. It is suitable for outdoor and well-lit indoor shooting environments and can provide stable performance under a variety of lighting conditions. This film has a classic fine grain structure and balanced contrast, and can present rich grayscale levels and solid black and white tones. It also has high resolution and a wide tonal range, allowing the picture to retain the traditional black and white texture and have a movie-like atmosphere.

name: Color 400
description: Perutz Color 400 is an ISO400 color negative film that supports the standard C-41 color negative processing process and can be processed in most film laboratories. This film is positioned as an all-rounder at medium to high speed, suitable for daily and creative shooting under various lighting conditions. The image style of Perutz Color 400 tends to be gentle and natural, with good color balance, the overall tone is not overly exaggerated, the color levels are delicate, the grain structure is moderate, and it has reliable clarity and tolerance performance. Whether in daylight, shadow or mixed light environments, it can produce realistic and expressive color effects, making it ideal for street photography, portraits, travel and daily records.

name: Image 160
description: Perutz Image 160 is an ISO 160 color negative film. This film is positioned as a classic, natural-style color negative film with low sensitivity, fine grain, and a fresh and balanced picture. Its color performance tends to be soft and slightly restrained, with highlights not overexposed and dark details well preserved. It presents a slightly nostalgic color texture, making it ideal for shooting in sunlight or in well-lit environments. Due to the ISO 160 setting, it has good exposure latitude between highlights and shadows, and is suitable for a variety of subjects such as portraits, landscapes, travel, street photography, and daily records. It also restores natural skin tones and performs stable gradation. The performance of Perutz Image 160 is neither as sharp as a high-contrast film nor as impactful as an oversaturated consumer-grade color film, but a more restrained, realistic, and beautiful color style.

name: PAN 100
description: Perutz Pan 100 is an ISO 100 black and white negative film suitable for traditional photography in well-lit environments. As a low-sensitivity film, it has fine grain and high detail expression, and presents natural grayscale transitions and clear levels of detail under medium contrast conditions. It is suitable for shooting landscapes, portraits, still life and daily scenes. This film has a good latitude and can preserve image details even with a slight push or underexposure, making it an ideal choice for photographers who pursue classic black and white textures. Perutz Pan 100 can be processed through standard black and white development processes, making shooting and processing easier.

name: PAN 400
description: Perutz Pan 400 is an ISO 400 black and white negative film positioned as a highly versatile black and white film that performs stably in a variety of lighting conditions. This film has moderate grain, good contrast and a wide exposure range. It can obtain usable images in both low-light environments and dynamic scenes. It is suitable for street photography, documentary, portrait and low-light shooting. Compared with the low-speed version, Pan 400 is more flexible and more tolerant when dealing with changes in light. It also uses the standard black and white development process, making the processing process simple and easy, suitable for daily and creative shooting.

name: B&W 600 Film
description: Polaroid 600 B&W photo paper is a black and white instant imaging photo paper specially designed for Polaroid 600 series cameras. name: Blue 600 Film
description: Polaroid Blue Duochrome is a special photo paper full of melancholy and calm beauty. It abandons full-color reproduction and instead uses deep blue and pure black to construct images. Due to its unique chemical properties, the highlights of the photo appear a bright icy blue, while the shadows remain a calm black tone. It is a favorite of photographers who shoot minimalist architecture, cold portraits, and photographers who pursue "melancholy aesthetics". Every image has a cold and dreamlike quality.

name: Color 600 Film
description: Polaroid 600 Color photo paper is a color instant imaging photo paper specially designed for Polaroid 600 series cameras. name: Color 600 Film Round Frame
description: Polaroid 600 Color Round Frame photo paper is a color instant imaging photo paper specially designed for Polaroid 600 series cameras. While retaining the traditional white border, the image is presented in a circular composition, making the photo more interesting and designed. 600 Color Round Frame photo paper is suitable for portraits, parties, travel and creative photography, providing a more playful and visually recognizable expression for instant photography.

name: Color GO Film
description: Polaroid Go Color photo paper is a color instant imaging photo paper specially designed for the Polaroid Go series of miniature instant cameras. This photo paper presents Polaroid's unique color image style, with warm tones, moderate saturation, soft highlights, rich shadow levels, and a natural texture. Go Color photo paper is suitable for portraits, parties, travel and daily records, emphasizing immediacy and fun, providing a creative and playable color expression for miniature instant photography.

name: Color SX-70 Film
description: Polaroid SX-70 Color photo paper is a color instant imaging photo paper specially designed for the SX-70 series instant cameras. It has a built-in battery that can directly power the camera. This photo paper presents the unique color image style of Polaroid, with warm tones, moderate color saturation, soft highlights, and rich shadow levels. description: Polaroid i-Type Color photo paper is a color instant imaging photo paper specially designed for Polaroid i-Type series instant cameras. It does not have a built-in battery and needs to be used with a camera that supports i-Type. The picture is full of texture and emotion unique to instant photography. name: Green 600 Film
description: Polaroid Green Duochrome brings a mysterious and vibrant visual dimension to instant photography. This photographic paper recreates the world with varying shades of green, creating a visual experience similar to that of old-fashioned night vision goggles or an old-growth forest. It works especially well with natural elements, blending plants, light and shadow, and the curves of the human body in an organic green tone. For photographers pursuing an absurd artistic or gothic style, Green Duochrome provides an excellent creative space, allowing the originally familiar scene to present an otherworldly beauty that is both eerie and charming.

name: Yellow 600 Film
description: Polaroid Yellow Duochrome is one of the most visually striking members of the range. It replaces the color layer with a highly saturated bright yellow, making the photo look like it's been passed through a strong yellow filter. This tone can give the picture an extremely strong sense of retro and warning, as if it is a wasteland movie scene from the future. Under strong light, the yellow part looks extremely dazzling and full of tension, which is very suitable for capturing the strong sunshine of summer, urban graffiti or portraits of characters with great personality. It's a great tool for exploring contrasts and experimental imagery that instantly captures the viewer's attention.

name: Infarared
description: Rollei Infrared is a creative and experimental black-and-white, infrared-sensitive film designed for photographers who want to push the boundaries of image expression. The film has extended infrared spectral sensitivity (approximately 650–750 nm) and can capture infrared reflections beyond the visible range, making vegetation appear brightly glowing and the sky deep and dark, creating a dramatic and surreal image effect known as the classic "Wood Effect." When there is no infrared filter, this film can be used as a conventional ISO 200-400 black and white negative film, and behaves as a high-sensitivity black and white film with fine grain, high resolution and clear sharpness; when using an IR filter (such as the R72 Crimson filter), it can significantly enhance the infrared imaging effect and present a unique light and shadow performance. Its transparent synthetic film base (PET) helps reduce film haze and improve scan clarity, and performs well in traditional darkroom or digital scanning processes.

name: RPX 100
description: Rollei RPX 100 is a medium-sensitivity classic black and white negative film with a nominal ISO100, suitable for shooting in a variety of lighting conditions. The film exhibits balanced contrast and good grain structure for stable imaging in conventional scenes. RPX 100 film retains the traditional texture of black-and-white images while having a moderate latitude that can easily handle a variety of subjects from landscapes to portraits. Its negatives are flat and easy to scan, making it a reliable choice for self-development and digital post-processing in the darkroom. Both beginners and advanced photographers can get satisfactory results.

name: RPX 25
description: Rollei RPX 25 is a low-sensitivity black-and-white negative film with a nominal ISO25, which is ideal for use outdoors with sufficient light or for shooting long exposures with a large aperture lens. This film has extremely fine grain and high resolution, can show clear details and rich grayscale levels, and is very suitable for landscape, architecture and detail-oriented creative photography. The contrast ratio of RPX 25 is medium to high, and it can express deep shadows and clear highlights under strong light conditions. The image effect is classic and expressive. Due to its low sensitivity, it encourages photographers to have finer control over light and composition.

name: RPX 400
description: Rollei RPX 400 is a high-sensitivity black and white negative film with a nominal ISO400/27° that combines flexibility with traditional artistic quality. The film performs well in low-light environments, has a wide exposure range and a balanced grain structure, making it suitable for street photography, documentary, sports and indoor low-light shooting. The RPX 400 has rich tonal gradations and moderate contrast. It can present clean highlights and solid black performance under the standard black and white development process, while retaining rich mid-gray tones. Its wide exposure tolerance also makes it suitable for slightly pushing or underexposing to achieve different image styles.

name: Retro 400s
description: Rollei Retro 400S is an ISO 400 full-color black-and-white negative film known for its high sensitivity and wide exposure range, making it suitable for general photography under various lighting conditions. It is also based on Agfa Aviphot-like emulsions, which have strong red light sensitivity and can capture deeper blacks, brighter whites and clear gray scales without filters, with sharp tonal contrast and fine grains. Retro 400S is particularly suitable for street photography, documentary, landscape and other multi-scenario applications, and shows strong fault tolerance under large changes in light and shade or under backlight conditions. In addition, it is also sensitive to light in the 650–750nm band, and can produce unique infrared-style images when used with an IR filter. The film uses a transparent PET substrate, which is convenient for scanning and large-size printing, and can be stably processed under standard black and white development processes.

name: Retro 80s
description: Rollei Retro 80S is a traditional black and white negative film with a nominal ISO 80 and a wide exposure tolerance, suitable for ultimate performance in well-lit scenes. It is based on Agfa Aviphot-like black-and-white photosensitive emulsion, which has an ultra-wide dynamic range and clear grayscale transitions. It also has extended sensitivity to red light, making it suitable for near-infrared photography when paired with deep red or IR filters. Retro 80S has fine grain and excellent sharpness, and can present rich gradation and contrast effects, making it suitable for landscape, portrait, and street photography.

name: Superpan 200
description: Rollei Superpan 200 is a classic medium-speed black and white negative film with a nominal ISO200/24° sensitivity, supports standard black and white development processing, and is suitable for 35mm and 120 roll formats. The film uses an ultra-panchromatic emulsion that responds to light in the visible range, while red light sensitivity extends to approximately 750nm, allowing it to produce near-infrared effects when using an infrared filter. This feature not only helps penetrate mist and soften atmospheric effects, but also provides more possibilities for creative imaging. Superpan 200's image performance is fine-grained, highly sharp, with moderate contrast and rich grayscale levels. Its wide exposure latitude means that flexible processing between EI125–250 can achieve robust details, making it a reliable choice for street photography, landscapes, portraits, and documentary photography; in practice, it can even be pushed to ISO400/27° to cope with low-light environments or higher shutter speed requirements.

name: GP3 100
description: Shanghai GP3 100 is a classic full-color black and white negative film renowned both at home and abroad. It is known for its high cost performance and extremely wide tonal performance. The imaging style of GP3 is very stable, and the contrast is adjusted just right, retaining rich shadow details and showing bright but not dazzling highlight transitions. Its graininess is medium to fine for 100-degree film, but it is very regularly distributed and has a typical traditional silver salt texture. What veteran players praise most is its "thickness" - the silver content of GP3 is quite generous among commercial rolls, which makes it extremely tolerant to various developers (such as D-76, Rodinal, HC-110). It is an introductory teaching tool for countless photography students and a cheap and reliable practice volume for large-format photographers.

name: GP3 400
description: Shanghai GP3 400 is a domestic black-and-white negative film with a nominal ISO 400 sensitivity, a full-color emulsion design, and supports standard black-and-white development processes. The film is coated in Europe, packaged and produced in China, and the original formula has been optimized to comply with modern chemical agent safety standards. As the high-speed version of the GP3 series, the GP3 400 has higher photosensitivity and latitude, and can maintain usable imaging in low light or dynamic scenes. The image style tends to have obvious grain and moderate contrast, showing a rough texture and rich layers full of classic black and white film flavor. It is very suitable for street photography, documentary, portrait and creative shooting in daily environments. Thanks to its ISO 400 setting, it's very tolerant to changes in light, allowing for stable performance in a variety of lighting conditions.

name: New GP3 100
description: Shanghai GP3 100 black and white negative film is a domestic black and white negative film with a nominal ISO100 sensitivity. It adopts a full-color emulsion design and supports standard black and white development processes. It can be processed in conventional darkroom or laboratory processes. The film has a well-controlled grain structure and balanced contrast, keeping the image clear and sharp without losing the black-and-white image texture of traditional film. The image style of the GP3 100 tends to be classic black and white, with deep black levels, bright white highlights, and rich grayscale transitions, making it suitable for a variety of shooting themes such as landscapes, street photography, portraits, and still lifes. Its low-speed positioning of ISO100 performs better in well-lit environments, but with appropriate push and development adjustments it can also achieve controllable results in low-light conditions. The design of this film is similar to that of early classic film, with fine grain and stable layers. It is suitable for beginner film enthusiasts to practice, and it can also be used as a daily choice for creators who pursue traditional black and white image quality.

name: Super 100
description: Shanghai Super 100 is a high-performance full-color black and white negative film produced by the Shanghai Photographic Factory. It is an advanced model in the "Shanghai brand" black and white film family, specially designed for photographers who pursue high resolution and rich tonal levels. A sensitivity of ISO 100 gives it extremely fine grain and stunning image sharpness. This film is known for its extremely wide grayscale span, able to delicately represent every tiny transition from deep black to transparent highlights. The coating process of Super 100 is more sophisticated and the emulsion layer is thicker, which gives it extremely strong exposure latitude and excellent tonal expression. It was the domestic product of choice for photographing artistic portraits, detailed landscapes and architectural photography, and represented the Shanghai-style industry’s ultimate pursuit of black and white image aesthetics.

Shenguang 400 is a domestic ISO 400 color film. It has a high sensitivity and is suitable for daily street sweeping, documentary recording and environments with normal light conditions. The overall contrast is medium to high, the graininess is relatively obvious, and the imaging style is tough, with a certain retro documentary feel. The tolerance is acceptable and not so harsh on exposure. It is also one of the common choices for domestic color negative films.

name: FN 125
description: Tasma FN 125 is a full-color black and white negative film with a strong Russian style. As the medium-sensitivity workhorse of the Tasma factory, ISO 125 sensitivity makes it ideal for all-day humanistic photography. The film's most notable feature is its extremely thin and tough clear polyester base, which gives it excellent light transmission and sharpness. In terms of imaging, FN 125 presents a visual characteristic of high contrast and low midtones, with deep dark areas and a rough and rhythmic grain texture. It has a special sensitivity to the red spectrum, allowing it to capture dramatic skies and powerful portraits. It is the ultimate black and white product for those photographers who pursue "original, rough and real" visual language.

name: FN 64
description: Tasma FN 64 is a low-sensitivity professional black and white negative film that pursues the ultimate in detail. The ISO 64 sensitivity allows for stunning resolution in well-lit environments. Compared with FN 125, FN 64 has finer grains and smoother grayscale transitions, but it still retains the cool, hard-core tone of the Tasma family. Due to the use of special industrial-grade photosensitive emulsion, it has unparalleled advantages in expressing architectural lines, metallic textures and delicate landscapes. The film's base is extremely thin and almost completely transparent, allowing it to retain a high level of transparency when scanned digitally. It is a representative of the refined production in Russian black and white film technology and is the best choice for creators who pursue the "digital sharpness of silver salt plates".

name: MAX 400
description: Vibe Max 400 is a 135-format color negative film with a nominal ISO400 sensitivity suitable for standard 35mm film cameras and conventional C-41 color negative processing processes. This film is positioned as a general-purpose color film and has good imaging stability under both sunlight and indoor light conditions. It has moderate grain and natural and layered color performance. The ISO400 setting improves flexibility in low-light environments, making it suitable for a variety of subjects such as street photography, portraits, travel, and daily recording.

name: MAX 800
description: Vibe Max 800 is a high-sensitivity 135 color negative film with a nominal ISO800 sensitivity that supports standard C‑41 color negative processing. This film is more flexible in low-light or dynamic scenes. Its higher sensitivity allows for more freedom in shutter settings, and it also has better exposure latitude. The color of VIBE Max 800 has a cinematic feel, with obvious grain and rich texture. It is suitable for creative scenes with changing light conditions such as night scenes, indoors, portraits, street photography and event recording.

name: PAN 100
description: Vibe Pan 100 is a black and white negative film with a nominal ISO 100 sensitivity, suitable for traditional black and white photography in well-lit environments. The film is designed in full color and can be processed through standard black and white development chemistry, making it easy to handle and compatible with most laboratory and darkroom processing processes. As a low-speed black and white film, Vibe Pan 100 has fine grain expression, balanced contrast and wide grayscale levels, and can present clear details and stable tones under good light. The ISO 100 setting makes it ideal for shooting landscapes, architecture, portraits and still life subjects. The images under bright light sources are smooth, natural and well-defined. This film is suitable for photographers and enthusiasts who want to experience classic black and white performance and traditional darkroom processing. Whether it is hand-processing exercises or daily creations, it can provide stable and film-like images.

name: PAN 400
description: Vibe PAN 400 is an ISO400 full color black and white negative film for use with standard 35mm cameras and is imaged via conventional black and white developing chemistry. Yashica 400 is an ISO 400 color negative film processed with C-41 process, suitable for daily shooting and use under various lighting conditions. This film performs particularly well under natural light, with warm colors and friendly skin tones, helping to present a soft and emotional picture style with moderate graininess, and the overall image style is textured and expressive.

name: Golden 80s
description: Yashica 80s is an ISO 400 color negative film released by the Yashica brand. It uses C-41 technology and is designed to provide an expressive color imaging experience. This film performs stably under natural light conditions, and its colors tend to be highly saturated and contrast-rich, making portraits, street photography, and landscape images more visually impactful. It also has moderate graininess and retains the atmospheric texture of traditional film. The image style of Yashica 80s is suitable for photographers who pursue bright colors and rich layers. It is a practical choice for lovers of film color expression and documentary style.

name: Ruby 60s
description: Yashica Ruby60s is an ISO400 color negative film launched by Yashica, suitable for standard 35mm film cameras and processed through the regular C-41 color negative film processing process.
